name: open_savings_account
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Open New Account page, choose SAVINGS in the account type dropdown, select the given account as the funding account, click Open New Account, and read the new account number shown on the 'Your new account number' line of the confirmation page into an output named new_account_id

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Open New Account page, choose SAVINGS in the account type dropdown, select the given account as the funding account, click Open New Account, and read the new account number shown on the 'Your new account number' line of the confirmation page into an output named new_account_id

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Open New Account page
steps.action: Click the 'Open New Account' link in the side navigation menu

steps.intent: Select SAVINGS as the account type
steps.action: In the account type dropdown, choose the SAVINGS option

steps.intent: Select the supplied account as the funding account
steps.action: In the funding account dropdown, select the option matching account_id

steps.intent: Read the new account number from the confirmation page
steps.action: On the confirmation page, locate the 'Your new account number' line and capture the account number value into the output new_account_id
